# Context and catalog-shape fixtures — preflight v1

Synthetic contract fixtures for `github-public-preflight-v1`. These are not GitHub responses, production policy defaults, authenticated ownership, live growth records or authorization to publish/initialize a character.

## Files and preservation

- Two additive Draft 2020-12 schemas: [context](../../../../schemas/evidence/v1/context.schema.json) and [preflight](../../../../schemas/evidence/v1/preflight.schema.json). They reuse fixed local original-schema URNs. The preflight schema narrows only existing fields; it does not relax closed original objects or introduce catalog-selection/trust flags.
- [cases.json](cases.json): 12 normal and eight insufficient-evidence supplements, eight matched context scenarios, 28 isolated staged errors and three regression variations.
- `normal/ES-N01–ES-N12` and `insufficient/ES-H01–ES-H08`: copied and supplemented context/evidence pairs. Their original case, record, source identity and XP/reward oracles remain linked explicitly.
- `contexts/normal/CTX-N01–CTX-N08`: every normal context explicitly names its matched synthetic candidate/evidence and, where applicable, actual previous bundle. N03 uses lossless large string IDs; N04 empty scope; N05 storage outside scope; N06 changed settings/scope; N07 inspection crosses UTC midnight; N08 additional/exclude overlap. Matching fixture associations do not authenticate any real source.
- `regressions/REG-N01–REG-N03`: recent review of an old PR, recent management of an old issue, genuinely linked nonempty multipage capture. Scope-change/storage-exclusion regressions are CTX-N06/N05.
- [context-probes.json](context-probes.json): 131 whole-context structural assertions, including every required field's omission/null/wrong type, closed nested objects, enums, IDs, fixed directives and intentionally schema-valid semantic contradictions.
- [catalog-probes.json](catalog-probes.json): 300 resource/target/purpose/window combinations plus seven intentional missing/failure/termination branches. Schema-valid unavailable evidence is not converted into schema corruption.
- [raw-cases.json](raw-cases.json), [boundary-cases.json](boundary-cases.json): eight invalid raw inputs and nine generated byte/depth descriptors. The invalid UTF-8 file is a hex byte descriptor, not the input document itself.
- [verification-results.json](verification-results.json): exact schema-only results.

All manifest paths resolve relative to this directory. `../v1/record-contexts.json#/contexts/<name>` selects an original synthetic bundle; `../../records/v1/valid/<name>` selects an original three-file fixture. This is trusted test-manifest plumbing, not context/evidence-directed retrieval.

The original `test/fixtures/evidence/v1`, original record fixtures and all original schemas remain byte-for-byte intact. Supplementation removes the old repository issue/activity pool, adds referenced PR/issue metadata captures, converts whole-parent files/commit–PR associations to snapshot windows, repairs capture provenance and distinguishes file/blob OIDs from parent commit OIDs. Source IDs, normalized growth facts, paid XP and original ledger snapshots are not rewritten.

## Expected stages are not executed semantic results

The manifest separates `contextSchemaExpected`, `evidenceSchemaExpected`, `catalogShapeExpected`, `expectedPreflight` and retained `futureSourceRewardOracle`. Expected preflight stages/codes are fixture targets, not a published report API. `semanticExecution: not_run` is deliberate.

H01/H02/H07/H08 target a future hold for missing/failed/truncated required capture. H03–H06 may pass only implemented structural preflight while their qualification-dependent history/actor/reflection/publication checks remain not_checked. No case's XP/reward oracle is claimed passed by this schema run.

Schema cannot establish mandatory request existence, exact W, referential kind/parent correctness, cursor consistency, comparable totals, policy catalog membership, historical sufficiency, source authenticity or reward correctness. All supplied established-proof labels remain untrusted claims. Fixture policy IDs/bodies remain test-only.

## Local schema verification — 2026-10-15

Using already installed Node/Ajv/ajv-formats/canonicalize/jsonc-parser, without dependency installation or remote resolution:

| Check | Result |
|---|---:|
| Evidence schemas compiled, including the two additive schemas | 6 |
| Cases / per-case context + base evidence + catalog schema assertions | 59 / 177 |
| Context probes / catalog probes | 131 / 307 |
| Reverse-order schema assertion replay | 615 |
| Strict raw-input failures / byte-depth boundaries | 8 / 9 |
| Linked record-schema assertions / ledger digest comparisons | 195 / 65 |
| Inputs byte-identical during verification | 156 |
| Pre-existing protected original files unchanged | 173 |
| Failures | 0 |

Raw checks reuse the original read-only strict parser's `status` role solely for its identical <=65,536-byte/depth-16 contract. This does not implement/integrate a context input adapter. ASCII and multibyte payloads test 65,535/65,536/65,537 bytes, and generated arrays test depths 15/16/17. Their raw acceptance is separate from context-schema rejection.

The schema registry used strict Draft 2020-12 validation, full asserted formats, no coercion/defaults/field removal, fixed local schemas only. Unknown external schema resolution failed locally with no network loader. Cases/probes were replayed in reverse order and input hashes rechecked. Original structural results (including 879 earlier probes) remain historical results, not new-profile assertions.

Source eligibility/history/completeness, binding/reference/closure semantics, reward order/allocation, progression/class/trait/achievement checks and source authenticity were not executed by this artifact-only verification. `progressionAuthorized` remains false. No product verifier, GitHub change, Actions execution, commit or push is part of this schema delivery.

## Reproduce the schema-only checks

### Subsequent local preflight implementation check

The separately authorized implementation adds a pure application use case and fixed local adapter composition in packages/commitkin. `node --test test/preflight.test.mjs` passes 247 tests, including all 59 case decisions, explicit raw/context/evidence boundaries, previous-record safety, binding/reference/required-request/capture-closure checks, replay/input preservation and fixed diagnostics. See [preflight-verification-results.json](preflight-verification-results.json). CTX-E01 intentionally retains the original record owner-check precedence before binding; the manifest's target is not a bypass of that earlier gate.

These runtime results do not replace the schema-only record above or mark original source/reward oracles executed. Qualification, temporal history, aggregate coverage, source authenticity and progression authorization remain outside preflight. The original fixture `semanticExecution` fields continue to describe those unexecuted source/reward targets.

Run from the project root, using the installed original package dependencies; no package scripts or executable verifier are added for this artifact-only check.

```sh
node --input-type=module <<'NODE'

import fs from "node:fs";import path from "node:path";import crypto from "node:crypto";
import Ajv from "./packages/record-validator/node_modules/ajv/dist/2020.js";
import formats from "./packages/record-validator/node_modules/ajv-formats/dist/index.js";
import canonicalize from "./packages/record-validator/node_modules/canonicalize/lib/canonicalize.js";
import {parseStrictJson} from "./packages/record-validator/src/infrastructure/strict-json.js";
const root="test/fixtures/evidence/preflight-v1",read=p=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")),a=new Ajv({strict:true,strictTypes:false,strictRequired:false,allErrors:false,coerceTypes:false,useDefaults:false,removeAdditional:false});
formats(a,{mode:"full"});const failures=[];
for(const n of ["common","state","ledger","status"])a.addSchema(read("schemas/v1/"+n+".schema.json"));
let schemas=0;for(const n of ["common","resources","collections","evidence","context","preflight"]){const s=read("schemas/evidence/v1/"+n+".schema.json");if(!a.validateSchema(s))failures.push({code:"INVALID_SCHEMA",name:n});a.addSchema(s);schemas++;}
const validators=Object.fromEntries(["context","evidence","preflight"].map(n=>[n,a.getSchema("urn:commitkin:schemas:evidence:v1:"+n)]));
const inventory=[];function walk(p){for(const d of fs.readdirSync(p,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=path.join(p,d.name);if(d.isDirectory())walk(f);else inventory.push(f)}}walk(root);walk("schemas/evidence/v1");
const hash=p=>crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(p)).digest("hex"),before=new Map(inventory.map(p=>[p,hash(p)]));
const check=(id,value,v,expected)=>{const old=JSON.stringify(value),got=v(value)?"SCHEMA_ACCEPT":"SCHEMA_REJECT";if(got!==expected)failures.push({caseId:id,expected,got,keyword:v.errors?.[0]?.keyword,instancePath:v.errors?.[0]?.instancePath});if(JSON.stringify(value)!==old)failures.push({caseId:id,code:"MUTATED_INPUT"});};
const manifest=read(root+"/cases.json").cases;let checks=0;
function runCase(c,prefix=""){const ctx=parseStrictJson(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,c.contextFixture)),"status"),e=parseStrictJson(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,c.evidenceFixture)),"ledger");for(const [role,value,expected]of [["context",ctx,c.contextSchemaExpected],["evidence",e,c.evidenceSchemaExpected],["preflight",e,c.catalogShapeExpected]])check(prefix+c.caseId+"/"+role,value,validators[role],expected);}
for(const c of manifest){runCase(c);checks+=3;}
let probes=0;const allProbes=[...read(root+"/context-probes.json").cases,...read(root+"/catalog-probes.json").cases];for(const c of allProbes){check(c.caseId,c.input,a.getSchema(c.schemaRef)??a.compile({$ref:c.schemaRef}),c.expected);probes++;}
let replays=0;for(const c of [...manifest].reverse()){runCase(c,"replay/");replays+=3;}for(const c of [...allProbes].reverse()){check("replay/"+c.caseId,c.input,a.getSchema(c.schemaRef)??a.compile({$ref:c.schemaRef}),c.expected);replays++;}
let raw=0;for(const c of read(root+"/raw-cases.json").cases){let bytes=fs.readFileSync(path.join(root,c.fixture));if(c.encodingDescriptor)bytes=Buffer.from(JSON.parse(bytes).bytes,"hex");let code="RAW_ACCEPT";try{parseStrictJson(bytes,"status")}catch(e){code=e.code}if(code!==c.expectedRaw)failures.push({caseId:c.caseId,expected:c.expectedRaw,got:code});raw++;}
let boundaries=0;for(const c of read(root+"/boundary-cases.json").cases){let bytes;if(c.bytes){const overhead=Buffer.byteLength('{"padding":""}'),n=c.bytes-overhead,fill=c.encoding==="multibyte"?"한".repeat(Math.floor(n/3))+"x".repeat(n%3):"x".repeat(n);bytes=Buffer.from('{"padding":"'+fill+'"}');if(bytes.length!==c.bytes)throw Error("WRONG_SIZE");}else bytes=Buffer.from("[".repeat(c.depth)+"0"+"]".repeat(c.depth));let code="RAW_ACCEPT";try{parseStrictJson(bytes,"status")}catch(e){code=e.code}if(code!==c.expectedRaw)failures.push({caseId:c.caseId,expected:c.expectedRaw,got:code});boundaries++;}
const resolved=new Map();function bundle(ref){if(resolved.has(ref))return resolved.get(ref);let b;if(ref.includes("#")){const [f,p]=ref.split("#");b=read(path.join(root,f));for(const k of p.split("/").filter(Boolean))b=b[k];}else b=Object.fromEntries(["state","ledger","status"].map(r=>[r,read(path.join(root,ref,r+".json"))]));resolved.set(ref,b);return b;}
let recordSchemas=0,digests=0;const digest=v=>"v1:sha256:"+crypto.createHash("sha256").update(canonicalize(v)).digest("hex");
for(const c of manifest){for(const ref of [c.baseRecordFixture,c.previousRecordFixture].filter(Boolean)){const b=bundle(ref);for(const[r,v]of Object.entries(b)){check(c.caseId+"/"+r,v,a.getSchema("urn:commitkin:schemas:v1:"+r),"SCHEMA_ACCEPT");recordSchemas++;}if(digest(b.ledger)!==b.state.integrity.ledgerHash)failures.push({caseId:c.caseId,code:"LEDGER_DIGEST"});digests++;}}
let externalRefRejected=false;try{a.compile({$ref:"https://example.invalid/never-fetch/schema.json"})}catch{externalRefRejected=true}if(!externalRefRejected)failures.push({code:"EXTERNAL_REF_ACCEPTED"});
let unchanged=0;for(const[p,h]of before){if(hash(p)!==h)failures.push({code:"INPUT_CHANGED"});else unchanged++;}
console.log(JSON.stringify({schemasCompiled:schemas,additiveSchemas:2,caseCount:manifest.length,caseSchemaAssertions:checks,contextProbes:read(root+"/context-probes.json").cases.length,catalogProbes:read(root+"/catalog-probes.json").cases.length,probeAssertions:probes,reverseAssertions:replays,rawChecks:raw,boundaryChecks:boundaries,recordSchemaAssertions:recordSchemas,ledgerDigestChecks:digests,externalRefRejected,inputFilesUnchanged:unchanged,failures,semanticExecution:"not_run",sourceAuthenticity:"not_checked",progressionAuthorized:false}));if(failures.length)process.exitCode=1;

NODE
```
